guide.overview: [CONTENT NEEDED] Explain Part 1's focus on clarity, evidence, and bias.
guide.what_you_do: [CONTENT NEEDED] Describe the 10-day curriculum structure, daily prompts, and checkpoint reflections.
guide.what_you_produce: [CONTENT NEEDED] List what they'll keep: clarity workbook, insights journal, final reflection.
guide.save_resume_behavior: Your daily responses save automatically. You can pause between days and return anytime. Progress is tracked across all 10 days.
guide.privacy_statement: All responses are stored locally in your browser. No data is sent to external servers or used for analysis.
guide.reset_behavior: You can reset Part 1 and start over. Resetting clears all responses. If you've exported your workbook, that file is saved separately.
guide.product_boundaries: Part 1 is an educational curriculum. It does not diagnose cognitive patterns, treat conditions, or replace professional consultation.
guide.accessibility_statement: Part 1 supports High Contrast, Readable Font, Text Scale, and Reduced Motion. Optional browser dictation is available.

launcher.role_description: A 10-day journey to build clarity and confidence in how you think.
